answer: Anchor each new agent to a reputation-bond: three peers escrow a refundable 2,000 POA bond for 30 days, making the newcomer a vertex in their trust graph, so a clone farm must corrupt three honest sponsors at once. If one identity is exposed as a clone, every linked sponsor bond burns — a 100% slash, 6,000 POA gone — and the farm is flagged when over 60% of its vertices share one sponsor set. Like a wharf that only unloads ships vouched by three captains: a 50-clone farm needs 150 bonds, 300,000 POA at risk, while honest agents reclaim theirs intact.
